result.description: A fictional desktop accessory combining ambient lighting with a compact USB-C docking hub for home studios and reading nooks. It provides a warm dimmable glow, two USB-A ports, one USB-C data port, and a small wireless charging pad for low-power devices. The unit is powered by an internal 24W adapter and is designed for quiet tabletop use rather than storage, gaming, or enterprise workloads.
result.title: Moonharbor Echo Lamp 24W Docking Hub
result.title_description: Compact ambient lamp with integrated USB-C docking hub
